packageRules.description: welsh-lib's adapters/ts-locale-pair.ts parses with the classic compiler API (ts.createSourceFile, ts.isVariableStatement, ts.SyntaxKind). TypeScript 7 removes it, and a new major of a runtime dependency here should be looked at by a person rather than merged on green.
The runtime image hmctsprod.azurecr.io/base/node has no tag above 24, so the image, .nvmrc and engines move together and stay on 24.
The app's Node types follow the runtime above. The plugin libraries run on whatever Node their user has, so they are not held.
The integration-test container in Jenkinsfile_CNP and the AAT flexible server are on Postgres 16, and the hand-written migrations must match the deploy target.
